title: 2 BOXES WITH OLD TINS ETC
findings: Two boxes. Large box of old tins includes petroliana: a BP Energol oil tin (green/white/yellow BP shield, 1950s-60s style), several squat round spouted oil/kerosene tins, a small rectangular spouted can and a red painted fuel/oil can. Also Spartan 'Velvet Wood Finish' varnish tin, Davis Old Fashioned Joiners Glues 500g packet (unopened), Mason's varnish tin, Country Life tobacco tin, Kerol(?) and other small polish tins, a blue enamel spouted can. Second smaller tray holds rusty hardware, washers, lock parts and oddments.

reason: Petroliana present (BP Energol oil tin and old oil cans) plus advertising tins (Spartan, Davis Glue, Country Life); collector interest despite condition.
